pages.text: Every royal teaches exactly one school. Tuition is payable in violence.

pages.title: The Curriculum
pages.text: $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/mobzilla)Mobzilla$() breathes Fire. The $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/kraken)Kraken$() deals Ice. The $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/the_king)King$() throws Lightning, the $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/the_queen)Queen$() keeps Holy, and the $(l:orespawn_integrations:bestiary/alien)alien brood$()'s boss hoards Ender.$(p)Land the killing blow yourself — the Court does not grade group work — and the scroll drops ready to learn or trade.

pages.title: The Odds
pages.text: The King and Queen teach most generously: 40% per kill, with scrolls rolled at 50-100% of their school's maximum level. Mobzilla pays 30% at 40-90%, the Kraken 30% at 30-80%, and the Alien Boss 15% at 20-70%.$(p)Rare enough to trade, common enough to chase — and Looting sweetens every table. Looting I lifts the King and Queen to 45% and Mobzilla and the Kraken to 35%, +5% per level after; the brood climbs 18, 21, 24.

pages.title: The Jackpot
pages.text: The King and the Queen each carry a second, separate roll: a flat 5% chance at a scroll rolled at 90-100% of maximum level. That near-guaranteed-max jackpot is the Court's trade currency — the scroll you frame, or the scroll you ransom.$(p)Your first boss scroll earns Scroll Scholar. Collect the curriculum.

pages.title: Spending It
pages.text: Read a scroll to learn its spell on the spot, or bank it — the same schools power the Court's $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/upgrade_orbs)upgrade orbs$(), because scrolls and orbs are one idea wearing two hats.$(p)Surplus royal gear funds the habit: the $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/court_economy)Uncrafting Table$() melts it back into queen scales.
